items.title: Agent Browser Test Shows EUR vs Screenshot THB
items.description: Test run of Hostelworld scraping using Agent Browser with mobile viewport showed EUR prices (Nomads €9.52, Base €7.07) while Trevor's screenshot showed THB prices (Nomads THB 1,098, Base THB 999). Possible causes: different dates, room type differences, currency/location-based pricing, or market changes between screenshot and test.

items.title: Broken Puppeteer Scraper Killed
items.description: After Trevor confirmed scraper prices were incorrect (showing THB 999 for Nomads when actual was THB 1,098), the broken Puppeteer-based scraper cron job was killed. Replaced with Agent Browser-based solution for accurate real-time price data.

items.title: MEWS Connector API Integration Completed
items.description: Sub-agent completed MEWS Connector API integration for payment polling on branch mews-api (commit 1e19c2d). New convex/mewsConnector.ts (1,312 lines) replaces webhook dependency with 15-minute cron polling. Supports per-hostel credentials, preserves towel deposit cashier filtering, uses AccessToken-only authentication. Added tables: mewsConnectorSyncLog, mewsApiCallLog. MEWS_CONNECTOR_IMPROVEMENTS.md includes 10 detailed recommendations.

items.title: MEWS Connector API PR Created
items.description: PR #8 created for MEWS Connector API Integration (Phase 1). Contains 5 commits: refactor, feat, docs. Includes manual 'Poll MEWS Now' button for debugging. Vercel warning about commit author email (not matching Trevor's GitHub account) - non-blocking.

items.title: Separate Git Identity for Clawd
items.description: Trevor requested separate git identity for Clawd/subagent commits to distinguish from his personal commits. Asked about GitHub Personal Access Token setup to allow Clawd to commit without exposing personal email.

items.title: Comprehensive Code Audit Completed
items.description: CODE_AUDIT_REPORT.md generated covering shift reports, reconciliation system, Convex code. Found: 8 critical improvements (N+1 queries, duplicate race condition, transaction isolation), 5 consolidation opportunities (merge MEWS modules, unify reports, standardize soft deletes), 4 error scenarios (timezone, float precision, FK constraints, webhook limits). Top priority: Fix N+1 queries (10x perf improvement), add duplicate protection, implement transaction isolation.

items.title: Phase 2: Webhook + API Consolidation In Progress
items.description: Phase 2 instructions sent to sub-agent to consolidate mewsWebhook.ts into mewsConnector.ts while keeping BOTH working simultaneously. Goals: Shared deduplication logic, N+1 query fixes, unique constraints, exponential backoff retry, circuit breaker pattern. Will commit to same mews-api branch and update/create PR.

items.title: Clawd Configuration GitHub Repository Created
items.description: Created GitHub repository 'calwd-second-brain' (https://github.com/tddixon/calwd-second-brain) at Trevor's request to back up Clawd configuration and skills. Contains AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, skills/ directory with 30+ installed skills, memory/ session logs, and docs/ documentation. Initial commit completed with git identity set to Trevor (trevor@nomads.com).

items.title: ClickUp-Obsidian Sync Requested
items.description: Trevor requested mapping and syncing existing ClickUp items to Obsidian with 1:1 alignment. Wants intelligent merging if projects already exist in Obsidian.

items.title: ClickUp API Token Not Configured
items.description: Sync blocked due to missing ClickUp API token. Trevor needs to generate token from https://app.clickup.com/settings/apps and configure CLICKUP_API_KEY environment variable.

items.title: Clawd User Creation in ClickUp
items.description: Trevor asked about creating @clawd user in ClickUp for task assignment. Users must be created in ClickUp interface (https://app.clickup.com/settings/members) with email and Member role, then agent needs User ID configuration.

items.title: Hybrid Integration Strategy
items.description: Decision made: Use BOTH custom agent (for main workflow - task execution, structure sync, 2-way Obsidian sync) and official ClickUp MCP (for advanced features like time tracking, chat, docs). Custom agent optimized for Trevor's workflow.
